answers.question: What should crews remove before the wet-season exercise?

evidence.title: Mainland drainage inspection
evidence.quote: The fictional mainland inspection found blocked culverts along the canal approach. Crews should remove plastic waste and accumulated sediment before the wet-season exercise. The maintenance plan prioritizes clearing the inlet grates, photographing each obstruction, and logging downstream water levels after cleaning. No pump purchase was approved. This brief recommends a follow-up inspection within seven days of the exercise. The record describes a training scenario and does not establish actual flood conditions in Lagos.
